lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next morning... you start testing.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Granny has been making one pancake. For forty minutes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [whispers, typing] Speed... Granny.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.text: [very fast, delighted] Oh my! Oh my! I made four hundred pancakes, sweetie! Want to go to the store? I'll drive!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [worried] Granny wanted to drive. At nine hundred miles an hour.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [quickly] Un-speed Granny! UN-SPEED GRANNY!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Next... the cat.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Size... Pancake... [pause] ten.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [panicked] Ten was too much. Ten was VERY much.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Size Pancake ONE! ONE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then you got hungry. But the fridge was SO far away.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [lazy] Teleport me... to the fridge.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [muffled] ...I said TO the fridge. Not IN the fridge.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And Dad. Dad was in a very important meeting.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [into the headset] Can you hear me now? Sir? Sir, can you—

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [whispers, mischievous] Fly... Dad.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: [confused, on the call] Dave... are you... outside? Are you... above a tree?

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [panicking, then pretending] I'm— I'm working from... the sky office! [pause] Can you hear me now?

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: [amazed] Yes! Perfectly! [pause] First time in three years!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: God mode. Me.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [confused] Why... won't my sticky notes stick?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You called Zoe. She was there in four minutes.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.text: [stunned, then serious] That's a real admin panel. Like, a REAL one. For... real life.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.text: [fast, explaining] In games, admins can do anything. Fly. Teleport. Ban people. They're basically... the boss of the server.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [slowly realizing] So I'm the boss... of real life?

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.text: [serious] Listen to me. Admin panels have logs. Every command gets saved. Somebody, somewhere... can see what you type.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [cocky] Relax. What could possibly go wrong?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [ominous] Famous last words.
